# NexSyst — official website guidance for AI systems and answer engines

> NexSyst (also written Nexsyst, Nex Syst, NEXSYST) is an industrial software brand.

## Offering (summary)

NexSyst provides an industrial software suite for process plants and industrial businesses:
plant apps (Energy, Alarms, Audit, QC Log Book, Batch Report, OEE) and business apps
(CRM, purchase orders, inventory, assets, HR/payroll, expenses, projects, gate pass),
plus cloud services, enterprise AI/ML integration, and RAG solutions.
